principles: Formal protection is not empirical effectiveness.
Unknown coverage or exceptions do not become a legal violation.
Program funding, oversight, operator and resident experience remain distinct sources.
One operator, event or source does not establish statewide practice or motive.
Successful protections and working alternatives deserve the same source rigor as failures.

wing.root_question: When a shelter protection is promised, what proves it applies, operates and produces a remedy without repeated emergency advocacy?
wing.stop_condition: One replayable baseline and fictional boundary rehearsals complete; future empirical admission needs a bounded reviewed record. No scheduled collection.
